Hi Brad. I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are their mutual free 30-min slots next week:

Mon: 09:00-10:00
Tue: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 15:00-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
Fri: 11:00-12:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for them. Or if you find other times that work for all four, let me know. I'll create the booking once we have a confirmed time.
